name: Firefly Aerospace Inc.
blurb: Firefly Aerospace is a space and defense technology company providing integrated launch and space services for national security, government, and commercial customers. Its launch portfolio includes Alpha, a small responsive launch vehicle, and Eclipse, a medium-lift rocket under development. On the spacecraft side, the company offers Blue Ghost, a lunar delivery and operations platform. The company IPO'd on August 7, 2025 and trades with a market cap of approximately $6.3 billion against trailing-twelve-month revenue of $184.9 million (+70.7% YoY), though it remains unprofitable with a net loss of $358 million.
recent: Firefly reported earnings on May 4, 2026, its most recent quarterly update. As of May 13, 2026, shares closed at $39.37 — near the analyst consensus price target of $40.13 (Buy) — but well off the 52-week high of $73.80, reflecting a significant drawdown since the post-IPO peak. Volume has been elevated at roughly 6 million shares, and the stock's 52-week low of $16.00 underscores continued volatility typical of pre-profitability space launch names.
